name: Plotwist
summary: Tracker for movies, series, anime and doramas: watchlist, episode progress, shared lists, stats and recommendations.
description: A platform for managing and reviewing movies, series, anime and dramas in one place. Mark titles watched, watching or planned, track episodes season by season, build and share lists, and see detailed statistics on a Pro plan; data comes from TMDB, and an iOS app plus a developer API extend it.
contains: statuses watched, watching and planned; per-episode tracking
free plan plus Pro: detailed statistics, badges, achievements, early access
iOS app; data provided by TMDB
